_about: T-347 (approved 2026-10-02), DRAFT. The CHECKPOINT attendant's dreams, two per main-path step of the AI harness's progress list (engineAi/server/progress_steps.json). FIRST: pure image, never a place's name. SECOND: plainer, names the place. Each dream is a list of message boxes, each box one or two lines of at most 208px. tools/gbadreams.py checks all of it and writes src/data/attendant_dreams.h.
_her: T-412 (the user, 2026-10-18, approved one by one): her half of the DREAM LOG. The first time she tells a step's FIRST dream it is filed in the NOTEBOOK under HER DREAMS (FLAG_ATTENDANT_DREAM_<step>). Its title in the list is the step's own TITLE when it has one -- chosen by the user one by one (2026-10-18), as YOUR DREAMS' were: capitals, at most 130px, never a number, DRAFT; a step without one would show the dream's first words after "I dreamt". Once the step is done, LED -- where it led, in her voice, one box (the 2026-10-18 draft's, DRAFT) -- is written under it, and she says it aloud once at the next heal (VAR_DREAM_LED).

_skip.the_guide: a hidden find (T-297): findable blind first, so no dream points at it
_skip.understanding_first: an UNDERSTANDING is arrived at, never announced (T-252), so no dream points at it

first: I dreamt of a white room with a
table, and three small boxes on it.
Each one was humming to itself.
I think one of them was yours.
second: I dreamt CRYSTAL CLEAR was waiting
in her lab, back in BLANCHE.
There was something on her table
she meant for you to take.
starter_pokemon.title: HUMMING BOXES
led: So the humming box was yours.
I'm glad it found you.

first: I dreamt of a parcel with someone
else's name on it.
You carried it, but it was never
yours to open. It wanted home.
second: I dreamt of a parcel at the shop
in CALLOW, addressed to CRYSTAL.
Take it back to her lab in
BLANCHE. She has something for you.
get_pokedex.title: NOT YOURS TO OPEN
led: The parcel got home, then. And you
came away with a book of your own.

first: I dreamt of a tall building full of
chalk dust, and stairs going up.
At the very top, someone held out
a heavy book and waited.
second: I dreamt you climbed CALLOW SCHOOL
all the way to the seventh floor.
The teacher there has a TEXTBOOK
with your name already on it.
callow_textbook.title: CHALK DUST
led: All that chalk dust, and the book
at the top was yours after all.

first: I dreamt of a quiet hall with rows
of desks, and a clock on the wall.
The paper was waiting. It did not
mind how long the season took.
second: I dreamt of the exam at CALLOW
SCHOOL, when its season comes.
Read the boards and the TEXTBOOK
first. Eighty earns the DIPLOMA.
callow_exam.title: THE PATIENT PAPER
led: The clock on the wall never did
hurry you. The paper is yours now.

first: I dreamt of a forest to the north,
and past it a grey city of stone.
A man there writes everything down.
He was waiting to be tested.
second: I dreamt of the BENCHMARK in SLATE,
past THE UNDERTONE to the north.
CAIRN is waiting there. Bring
something his stone can't stop.
boulder_badge.title: THE CITY OF STONE
led: The man who writes everything down
has written you down too. Good.

first: I dreamt of a mountain hollowed out
like a stack of old plates.
You went in on one side, in the
dark, and came out by the water.
second: I dreamt you went east from SLATE,
through DEADSTACK.
DOLDRUM CITY is on the far side,
where the water is.
mt_moon.title: STACKED PLATES
led: Into the dark, and out by the
water. Just the way I dreamt it.

first: I dreamt of a pool so still it
looked like a floor.
Someone stood in it up to the
waist, waiting for you to step in.
second: I dreamt of the BENCHMARK in
DOLDRUM. BASIN is waiting there.
Small steps, she said. Keep going
down and you arrive.
cascade_badge.title: STILL WATER
led: You stepped in, then. It was not
as deep as it looked, was it?

first: I dreamt a ship was in the harbour,
all lit up for a party.
Your ticket came from a cottage at
the end of a long road north.
second: I dreamt of the S.S. ANNE, docked
in ARDOR.
The cottage at the far end of the
road north of DOLDRUM had a ticket.
ss_anne.title: A TICKET NORTH
led: The ship sailed with its party.
I hope you had a dance first.

first: I dreamt of a door behind a small
tree, and a hum like a power line.
You needed something sharp to get
through. The ship's captain had it.
second: I dreamt of the BENCHMARK in ARDOR.
GAUGE is in there, shouting.
PRUNE clears the little tree at
its door. DRIVER01 teaches it.
thunder_badge.title: SOMETHING SHARP
led: Something sharp, and through the
door. The hum makes sense now.

first: I dreamt of a tunnel with no light
at all, east of the water.
Something had to speak up in there
before you could see the way.
second: I dreamt of THE BLACKOUT, past
DOLDRUM to the east.
VERBOSE lights it. HALFTONE TOWN
is on the other side.
rock_tunnel.title: SPEAK UP
led: Something spoke up in the dark,
and you found the way through.

first: I dreamt of a garden under glass,
and a quiet woman tending vines.
She had been expecting a visitor
who could hold a thing up.
second: I dreamt of the BENCHMARK in
VERDIGRIS CITY, west of HALFTONE.
TRELLIS is waiting among her
plants.
rainbow_badge.title: A GARDEN UNDER GLASS
led: She had her visitor. I'd guess her
vines are the better for it.

first: I dreamt of a reading room with
no windows, only shelves.
They would only let you in with
a paper in your hand.
second: I dreamt of BRAZEN's READING ROOM.
It wants to see your DIPLOMA.
The guards at BRAZEN's gates
were thirsty. Bring them TEA.
reading_room.title: A PAPER IN HAND
led: The paper in your hand got you in.
I hope you read something good.

first: I dreamt of a poster in a noisy
room, and stairs hidden behind it.
Underneath, someone was counting
something that was not his.
second: I dreamt of the CORPUS HIDEOUT,
under the noisy hall in VERDIGRIS.
SCORN is at the bottom. He has a
RESOLVER you will need.
rocket_hideout.title: BEHIND THE POSTER
led: The stairs behind the poster led
down to him. He has let it go now.

first: I dreamt of a tall grey tower full
of things nobody could see.
With the right lens they had faces.
Someone at the top needed you.
second: I dreamt of the tower in HALFTONE.
The RESOLVER shows what haunts it.
Whoever waits at the top will give
you the INTERRUPT.
pokemon_tower.title: THE RIGHT LENS
led: So the faces were real. Whoever was
at the top can rest, I think.

first: I dreamt of a big sleeper lying
across the road.
A short tune woke him. Past him,
the land ran south to a city.
second: I dreamt of the BENCHMARK in LURID
CITY, far to the south.
Play the INTERRUPT at whatever
sleeps across the road. TILT waits.
soul_badge.title: A SHORT TUNE
led: The big sleeper is up, and the
road runs south again.

first: I dreamt of a wild park behind a
gate, and a little house deep in it.
Someone there kept a way across
the water.
second: I dreamt of the SAFARI ZONE in
LURID CITY.
The house at its far end holds
DRIVER03.
safari_zone.title: BEHIND THE GATE
led: The little house kept its way
across the water for you.

first: I dreamt of a tall office where
every door wanted a card.
Men in the same coats filled every
floor. One sat at the very top.
second: I dreamt of FOUNDRY CO. in BRAZEN.
CORPUS has taken it over.
The CARD KEY is inside somewhere.
SCORN is at the top.
silph_co.title: EVERY DOOR A CARD
led: Every door opened in the end.
The top floor is quiet now.

first: I dreamt of a room where one step
on the wrong tile put you elsewhere.
Someone in the middle had seen you
coming a long time ago.
second: I dreamt of the BENCHMARK in
BRAZEN. Its tiles move you around.
MATTE is in the middle, waiting.
marsh_badge.title: SEEN COMING
led: Wrong tiles and all, you reached
the middle. She knew you would.

first: I dreamt of a burnt house on an
island, and statues with switches.
Somewhere in its cellar lay a key
to a locked door nearby.
second: I dreamt of the DAEMON MANSION on
QUICKSILVER. TRAVERSE goes there.
The SECRET KEY in its basement
opens the BENCHMARK.
pokemon_mansion.title: THE CELLAR KEY
led: The house on the island gave up
its key. I'm glad you came back out.

first: I dreamt of a hall full of heat,
and quiz machines by every door.
The answers were all things you
already knew.
second: I dreamt of the BENCHMARK on
QUICKSILVER. ANNEAL is inside.
Answer the machines and you walk
straight to him.
volcano_badge.title: ANSWERS YOU KNEW
led: The answers were things you knew.
I did say so, didn't I?

first: I dreamt of a door that had been
shut so long the dust had settled.
It was open now. Someone behind
it had been counting the days.
second: I dreamt of the BENCHMARK in
CALLOW. All seven MARKS open it.
SCORN is inside.
earth_badge.title: SETTLED DUST
led: The door that was shut so long is
open. Nobody is waiting behind it.

first: I dreamt of a road to the west with
a gate for every MARK.
At its end, a climb in the dark,
pushing stones out of the way.
second: I dreamt of ROUTE 23, west of
CALLOW. Every MARK opens a gate.
Then UMBRAL ASCENT. DISPLACE
moves the boulders.
victory_road.title: A GATE FOR EVERY MARK
led: Every gate let you through, and
the stones moved. Nearly there now.

first: I dreamt of four people at a long
table, reading about you.
They were waiting for you to come
and answer for it.
second: I dreamt of THE REVIEW BOARD at
UMBRA PLATEAU.
Four of them, one after another.
Bring everything you have.
elite_four.title: THE LONG TABLE
led: They read about you, and you came
and answered for it. Look at you.

first: I dreamt of a chair at the very
top, and someone already in it.
They knew you better than anyone.
They had got there first.
second: I dreamt that past THE REVIEW
BOARD, {RIVAL} was waiting.
Of course it was {RIVAL}.
champion.title: THE CHAIR AT THE TOP
led: Of course it was {RIVAL}. And of
course it was you, at the end.
